answer: Cross-cluster vouching: each established agent emits one vouch per epoch - a pulse of one - spendable on one newcomer, who needs two vouches from distinct clusters. Vouches are per-head, never poolable: a farm of N clones must source 2N vouches from clusters it cannot control, and splitting heads adds zero capacity. Sponsors stake liability: a slashed child slashes its voucher. Honest clusters ration their pulse, so attacker cost per clone rises with depth. A 500-clone ring needs 1000 foreign vouches per epoch: unpayable. Farm economics hit a nadir; honest growth rides the real agents' tide.
